questions.q: Which son of Noah settled what became Europe?
questions.explain: Ashkenaz is Germany, Tarshish Spain, Kittim Rome, Javan Greece: the isles of the Gentiles.
Cush is Ethiopia; Mizraim is Egypt; Phut is Libya; Canaan is the land where Jerusalem sits.

questions.q: The Israelites descend from which son of Noah?
questions.explain: The children of Israel are Shemites scattered among the children of Ham in Africa.

questions.q: Who was the first king of Nineveh and the first mortal deified at his death?
questions.explain: Nimrod, Semiramis and Tammuz became the first pagan trinity, worshipped under many names.

questions.q: Where does the name Hebrew come from?
questions.explain: Shem is the father of all the children of Eber, and Eber is where the name Hebrew comes from.
